mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, light intensity shower rain. Next 24 hours: high 15, low 6.

Kosovo police have opened a criminal case in Ohri after a 26-year-old woman was brutally beaten, and a recent death of a 17-year-old girl in Bogdanci underscores rising violence against women; officials say prosecutors and courts must act without pressure or privilege.

Italian police in Trieste dismantled a cocaine trafficking network, arresting five people, including three Italian nationals, as part of a larger anti-drug operation.

Balfin Group has been listed among the 100 largest companies in Southeast Europe in the SEE TOP 100 ranking, according to its president Samir Mane.

The Office of the People's Advocate opened a new branch in Mitrovica North, allowing residents of four municipalities to file complaints directly with the institution.

Digital-security expert Drenusha Salihu warned that while technology permeates daily life, online risks are growing and urged users to protect personal data and payments.
